facts.text: I want an SEO meta description for an article in less than 160 characters including spaces.
The article discusses possible negative effects of long-term intermittent fasting.
The article concludes that daily intermittent fasting seems to be quite safe for the majority of people.
The article addresses the effect of intermittent fasting (IF) on bone health.
The article mentions a recent review of the literature published in the British Journal of Nutrition.
The review studies pulled studies from the MEDLINE database until September 30, 2022.
The review studies included IF protocols including the 5:2 diet, alternate day fasting (ADF), and time-restricted eating (TRE).
The article says some animal studies used intermittent fasting and other practices known to harm bone health.
The article says animal study results would be very difficult to extrapolate to humans.
The article says observational human studies suggest a link between some IF practices such as skipping breakfast and compromised bone health.
The article says observational studies did not control for confounding factors.
The article defines an observational study as one where researchers do not make any active experimental intervention.
The article says interventional studies included in the review suggest time-restricted eating protocols up to six months do not adversely affect bone health.
The article says time-restricted eating protocols up to six months may have some modest protective effect on bone health.
The article says studies that looked at alternate day fasting (ADF) showed no negative effects on bone health.
The article says no studies looked at the 5:2 diet and bone health outcomes.

The article says the interventional studies were limited by short duration, small and diverse population samples, assessment of total body bone mass exclusively by DXA, and inadequate control of factors affecting bone outcomes.
The article says much more research is needed to make a definite call.
I practice time-restricted eating protocols up to six months.
The article recommends protecting bone health with adequate vitamin D.
The article recommends protecting bone health with adequate calcium intake from calcium-rich foods.
The article recommends protecting bone health with vitamin K2.
The article recommends strength training along with weight-bearing exercise to protect bone health.

keyphrases: vitamin D calcium vitamin K2 strength training weight-bearing exercise
